title: Polarization
extract:
Not to be confused with  Mag's  Polarize.
Polarization is the process by which a Polarity is added to or modified on a mod slot to a Weapon, Companion, or Warframe, allowing an individual piece of equipment to use more mods and effectively increase its power beyond its original capacity. A  Forma is required to polarize an item.

Application

Polarization becomes available to equipment only when it has reached Rank 30. The option is displayed and applied in a similar fashion to the  Orokin Reactor or  Orokin Catalyst, by means of  Forma or its variants ( Omni Forma,  Stance Forma, and  Umbra Forma).

Apply the Forma.
Select a mod slot to polarize. You can cycle through the different Polarities by clicking the slot multiple times. This includes slots that already have polarizations.
Click "Apply".

Notes
After the equipment has been polarized once, players can use the Swap Polarity function to rearrange the polarized slots (but not the Stance Slot), including innate polarities.
 polarities can only be added by using an  Umbra Forma, which can be obtained from Nightwave, Teshin's Steel Path rewards, or Gift from the Lotus alerts.
 polarities can only be added using an  Omni Forma, which can be obtained from the Market, rarely from Arbitrations, Temporal Archimedea, Elite Temporal Archimedea, the 1999 Calendar, and Nightwave.
 Stance Forma is required to apply the polarity to a melee weapon's Stance slot.
Aura Slots may benefit from this polarity if users wish to use different Aura Mods on different configs.
Polarizing will reset the equipment to rank 0 and it will have to be leveled again.
Ranking up equipment that has been polarized will not give additional Mastery Points.
After polarizing Warframes, Archwings, and Necramechs, equipment will retain ability unlocks and/or ranks as if the equipment's rank were equivalent to the player's mastery rank (stats will still reset to rank 0, however). For example:
At Mastery Rank 10, newly polarized equipment has all abilities unlocked at rank 0.
At Mastery Rank 20, newly polarized equipment has all abilities unlocked with the first ability at rank 3 and the other abilities at rank 1.
At Mastery Rank 30, newly polarized equipment has all abilities unlocked at rank 3.
Polarizing does not remove any Orokin Catalysts, Orokin Reactors or Focus Lenses from the equipment - however, the equipment will not generate Focus before it is leveled to its maximum rank again.
For each Forma used on equipment, an emblem with a star will contain the number of Forma used on the equipment, visible at the top of the upgrade menu (to the right of its name and rank).
If Mods are installed into the equipment that is being polarized, as many mods are left installed as possible with the resulting mod capacity and the rest will be uninstalled (and unaffected). Priority goes from Aura/Stance, Exilus, top row left to right, then bottom row left to right.
Choose the target equipment, slot and polarity wisely, as the Forma cannot be refunded, and polarization can only be removed or changed with going through the process again and consuming another Forma.
Already polarized slots can also be unpolarized, but the Forma will still be consumed.
A Warframe, Archwing, or weapon that has been polarized once can have their Secondary Energy Color customized.

Tips
Re-polarizing slots for which you are forced to pay a penalty is the most efficient use of the Forma. Instead of just doubling mod capacity for one slot, you are essentially getting double + 1 for a slot that you would otherwise be paying a penalty for.
It is usually advised to first start with supercharging the equipment with an Orokin Reactor or Catalyst before polarizing slots, as the extra mod capacity is much more efficient than dividing the costs of mods.
Orokin Reactors and Catalysts give you 30 extra capacity when the equipment is at rank 30. To match this with Formas, one would need to polarize 4 slots (consuming 4 Forma) - and these slots would need to be equipped with two 14-drain and two 16-drain mods, such as  Redirection,  Steel Fiber,  Blind Rage and  Transient Fortitude, as well as going through the re-levelling process every time. The extra mod capacity granted by supercharging is also more beneficial when going through the re-levelling.
With their mostly low-drain mods and capacity-increasing Stances, melee weapons can usually have fully ranked mods in every slot by just using a Catalyst - especially if they have innate polarities.
